title: github.git.push v1 arguments
description: EffectDescriptor.arguments for effect_type github.git.push. The repository comes only from the validated target github.com/{owner}/{repo}. base_sha is the exact current SHA required at refs/heads/{head}; the new commit has that sole parent, and the ref update uses force=false. The default branch cannot be written. The gateway digests the exact argument bytes. The same closed file/path and UTF-8 rules as branch.create_from_changes apply.

base.description: The intended pull-request base branch; base_sha binds the current head of the branch being pushed.

base_sha.description: Expected current refs/heads/{head} commit SHA, and the new commit sole parent.

head.description: The existing branch to advance by one non-force commit; never the default branch.

files.description: Files added or replaced relative to base_sha. v1 has no deletes, symlinks, submodules or binary content.

content_utf8.description: The file content. At most 49152 characters here; the gateway also caps it at 49152 bytes.

x-helm.idempotent: conditional: exact expected head SHA and force=false fast-forward update; replay reads back the resulting commit before another write
x-helm.observable: yes: ref, parent, compared paths and blob SHA-1s are read back
x-helm.reversible: yes: a later governed commit may revert the change
